text:
marta: Late-shift check-in — GPU fleet / provisioning. Quick standup:
• What I did: prewarmed AMS spot pool (+5 nodes), drained two noisy test nodes (node-ams-test-12/13), validated that dedicated lanes stayed steady.
• Blockers: ams1 still showing soft quota limit on p2-type. Spikes on allocation when batch jobs start, hitting cloud API 429s.
• Today: want to confirm fallback routing works and run a small canary for the new scheduling tweak. @alex can you escalate quota ticket?

alex: Saw the 429s around 18:02 UTC. Opened INC-4021 with cloud support; they asked for sample request IDs, gave them runbook logs. ETA currently ~45-90m. I also bumped retry window to 8s for provisioning agent as a temporary mitigation.

sam: ack. I can re-run the drain if any pods are stuck. Quick check: which node still has the backlog?

marta: node-ams-test-13 had ~12 pending init containers, mostly non-prod eval jobs. I cordoned it and rescheduled. No user-facing error reported.

sam: thanks. If anyone needs the command: ```kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=node-ams-test-13```

riley: FYI I noticed small-batch tail latency creeping up in AMS after the drain (~p95 +70ms). Might be kernel fallback kicking in on one of the TPU-like instances. I'll add a short metric check and post dashboard link.

jin: If quota fix is delayed, we should route low-priority non-prod to eu-west-2 as fallback. Quick mapping suggestion in our routing rules: 
```
if region == "eu-west-1" and pool == "non-prod" -> prefer eu-west-2
```
That avoids eating into dedicated buffers.

infra-bot: deploy-bot scheduled canary rollout for model-scheduler v2 to ams1 at 18:45 UTC. Will post success/failure.

alex: update — cloud support added capacity temporarily, INC-4021 updated. They warned about a quota guard hitting again if we spike >120% for more than 5m. Still working on permanent quota increase; I'll ping legal/finance for a quota request if needed.

marta: cool, thanks. Plan: wait for cloud confirm, run canary at 18:50 (after deploy-bot), monitor p95/p99 and provision API errors. If quota retriggers, switch non-prod fallback to eu-west-2 and open a short blameless note.

sam: quick question — do we need a manual override on the autoscaler to prevent aggressive scale-ups during the canary?

riley: yes please — set autoscaler burst_limit to 2 for the canary window. I'll add the metric alert for pod evictions.

marta: done — autoscaler burst_limit -> 2 for next 30m. I'll post a short recap after canary. :thumbsup:
